description:
You arrive in a kitchen. A standard one.

You can see an opened fridge in the corner. The fridge contains a red apple and a white onion, so there's that. As if things weren't amazing enough already, you can even see an oven. You see a table. Wow, isn't TextWorld just the best? Looks like someone's already been here and taken everything off it, though. You see a counter. You see a banana, a red hot pepper and a cookbook on the counter. I mean, just wow! Isn't TextWorld just the best? You can make out a stove. The stove is conventional. But oh no! there's nothing on this piece of garbage. Oh! Why couldn't there just be stuff on it?



There is a fried yellow potato, a diced fried red onion and a diced fried red potato on the floor.
inventory: You are carrying: a knife, a fried carrot and a diced orange bell pepper.
